plan.notes: Official ASU major map (Applied Science (Technical Communication), BAS, plan LSTECBAS, campus ASU00); term-by-term sequence as published; retrieved 2026-10-06. One map row = one seed slot. 'X or Y' alternatives transcribed as one choice slot (choice=true). Rows with large option pools transcribed as one choice slot naming the requirement. Gen-ed placeholders (no course link on the map) transcribed verbatim as choice slots. Map 'Term hours subtotal' rows are metadata, not courses (wave-33 convention). The official map lists the following slot(s) in more than one term; transcribed as shown with allow_repeated_courses per the genuine-repeat rule: Any needed lower division General Studies requirement OR Elective. program_type='completion': the official major map sequences only the upper-division ASU portion (Terms 5-8); the community-college prerequisite block is listed under external_prereqs, per the program_type rule.
